name: emil-design-eng
summary: Emil Kowalski's design-engineering skill for AI agents: UI polish, animation decisions, gestures, performance and accessibility.
description: A SKILL.md package that teaches an AI coding agent Emil Kowalski's design-engineering approach: an animation decision framework, spring animations, component building principles, CSS transform and clip-path techniques, gesture handling, performance and accessibility rules, and a required review format. Installs with the skills CLI from the emilkowalski/skills repo.
contains: SKILL.md package installed with npx skills add
animation decision framework: whether to animate, purpose, easing, duration
CSS transform, clip-path and stagger animation techniques
gesture, drag, performance and accessibility rules
